dependency_notes: Uses Java 8 or later with no project-specific dependencies. Returns an absolute path and uses the first dot in the final filename as the suffix insertion point. Filesystem I/O failures propagate as UncheckedIOException. Concurrent callers can receive the same path because the method leaves file creation to the caller.
